message.content:
{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "name: test
on:
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - '*'
  push:
    branches:
      - 'dev'
      - 'master'

jobs:
  go-generate:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Go Version
        uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: '1.24.11'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: go generate
        run: go generate ./...
      - name: check generated files
        run: |
          git diff --exit-code
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            git status --porcelain
            echo "::error::go generate ./... produced untracked files"
            exit 1
          fi

  unit-tests:
    runs-on: ubuntu-22.04
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v3
      - name: Go Version
        uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: '1.24.11'
      - name: Cache Go modules
        uses: actions/cache@v4
        with:
          path: ~/go/pkg/mod
          key: ${{ runner.os }}-go-${{ hashFiles('go.mod', 'go.sum') }}
          restore-keys: |
            ${{ runner.os }}-go-
      - name: test
        env:
          LD_LIBRARY_PATH: ${{ github.workspace }}/libs
          LITE_SERVERS: ${{ secrets.LITE_SERVERS }}
        run: |
          sudo apt-get install -y libsecp256k1-0
          mkdir -p ${{ env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}
          wget https://github.com/tonkeeper/tongo/raw/master/lib/linux/libemulator.so -O ${{ env.LD_LIBRARY_PATH}}/libemulator.so
          make test
",
  "rationale": "The workflow is a Go CI (go.mod/go.sum present, Makefile runs go test) with two jobs that fetch and build Go dependencies on every run but have no dependency cache. The measured experiment batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9 (pattern P-LIT-GHA-CACHE) added a Go module cache keyed on go.mod/go.sum and reported reduced elapsed time, and the pattern's preconditions (repeated dependency fetching, lockfile inputs) are met by this repository's CI history and lockfiles. Adding actions/cache@v4 for ~/go/pkg/mod to both jobs preserves all existing build/test steps, timeouts, permissions, and secrets, with no new privileged actions, publishing, deployment, or network endpoints.",
  "evidence_ids": ["experiment:batch-interactive-three--f6d2974a5cef7cc9", "pattern:P-LIT-GHA-CACHE"]
}

on:

          git diff --exit-code
          if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
            git status --porcelain
            echo "::error::go generate ./... produced untracked files"
